answer:
In Ollama version 0.32.10 and later, models that do not set their own `repeat_penalty` default to 1.0, which is "off." This change matches the settings of other engines and helps speed up speculative decoding. This information is specified in the context from the document:

- "Models that don't set a `repeat_penalty` now default to 1.0 (off) instead of 1.1, matching other engines and speeding up speculative decoding; set a per-model parameter if an older model repeats itself." [ollama/v0.32.10.md (lines 1-9)] 

This default setting applies to all versions following 0.32.10.
